results.title: We, Brothers
results.overview: Two old fellow mobsters meet up at hideout to discuss their next job. They plunge into a conversation recollecting their past deeds together, which leads them into argument and rivalry, until one of them realizes something is quite wrong.

results.title: Der Schimmelreiter
results.overview: North Friesland today: After the death of his father-in-law, Hauke Haien takes on two important roles in coastal protection - dyke count and director of coastal protection. Professionally, Hauke is the best man for the job; he is a visionary who lives and thinks in harmony with nature. Only people are not his cup of tea. As a loner, Hauke hardly knows how to inspire an audience and win over fellow campaigners. His warnings about the effects of climate change are dismissed as hysteria in the village, even though the coastal inhabitants know that a drastic change of course in climate policy is unavoidable. Fortunately for Hauke, his wife Elke supports him. She manages to make him heard. But Hauke does not enjoy his success for long, because when it becomes known that his plans are much more radical, he is met with incomprehension and anger. Resistance and pressure wear on him. Disaster can no longer be averted.

results.title: Dracula: The Night Around Us
results.overview: In this modern reimagining, Dr. John Seward regains his hope for humanity through a bond with Mina and her young daughter Lucy. However, his regained faith is systemically destroyed by an ancient evil.

results.title: The Pen That Will Not Bow
results.original_title: The Pen That Will Not Bow
results.overview: The early life of Voltaire, before he became one of Europe's most influential writers and philosophers.

results.title: Anaconda: Blood Coil
results.overview: A group of friends are terrorized by an anaconda during their vacation.

results.title: Studio Dream
results.overview: Studio Dream is an experimental film about working with art models.

results.title: Espresso
results.overview: Set in LA 2015, we follow the rise of an actor, Andrew Thompson, during a chemistry read for an upcoming superhero movie, while falling in love in the process with his soon-to-be co-star.

results.title: The Delivery
results.overview: A college student furious over a late night delivery takes his frustration out on an elderly driver, unaware of the ordeal that forced him to arrive on foot.

results.title: How Do You Remember The Matrix?
results.original_title: How Do You Remember The Matrix?
results.overview: In the year 2073, where all copies of films have been lost in a sea of AI-generated replicas, two detectives seek out the original copy of 'The Matrix'.

results.title: Mirrors
results.overview: Upon returning home after spending seven years living in Spain, Inés must adapt to a reality that is not what she left behind. Her family’s expectations, accumulated tensions, and her grandmother's deterioration make her return more complicated than she imagined.

results.title: Uniform: Cinta di Balik Seragam
results.overview: Young officer Jason must face a bitter reality. Lara, his girlfriend, has been murdered in a staged accident. Noticing numerous inconsistencies, he asks the Commander to join the investigation. A series of events reveals facts linking a criminal syndicate to the tragedy that befell his girlfriend.

results.title: Branch On A Tree
results.overview: As a result of a rape, Jayne found herself saddled with a son suffering from severe visual impairment. After eight years Jayne feels she cannot take it anymore as it is clear to her that no bond has been established between her and her son. Hence, she decides to give him up.

results.title: The Tahquitz Myth
results.overview: A Palm Springs college student sets out to disprove an ancient Coachella Valley myth... only to discover a terrifying truth.

results.title: Water Body
results.overview: An immersive audiovisual experience using global Earth systems datasets to explore water as the connective tissue of life revealing its continuous movement through rivers, oceans, landscapes and living beings as one planetary circulation.

results.title: Vice and Virtue
results.overview: When celestial rivals Vice and Virtue bet on the fate of six unsuspecting humans, chaos ensues and secrets unravel. As free will collides with divine meddling, lives spiral in this darkly comedic tale of power, morality, and choice.

results.title: Murs
results.overview: Eric is a 45-year-old man. He eagerly rummages through the clothes in a children's store, then cracks open a fitting room door. A customer harshly calls out to him. Eric runs away.

results.title: The Exposure
results.overview: Lili's summer holidays take an unexpected turn when her mother pressures her to ask Dorsday, a family friend, for money to keep her father out of prison. That night she loses not only her dignity but every certainty she once had.
